title: Auto insurance guide (CB020) - Texas Department of Insurance
claims: TDI states that Texas law requires at least $30,000 of coverage for injuries per person, up to a total of $60,000 per accident, and $25,000 of coverage for property damage.
TDI states that all auto policies in Texas include personal injury protection coverage, and that a policyholder who does not want it must tell the company in writing.
TDI states that insurance companies must offer uninsured/underinsured motorist coverage, and that a policyholder who does not want it must tell the company in writing.
The guide carries a last updated date of December 11, 2025.
The guide states no effective date for the minimum amounts.
updateCadence: TDI revises its consumer guides periodically; re-verify annually and after each legislative session.
